Description: Susceptible humans become exposed through bites by infectious mosquitoes.
A fraction ρ of exposed individuals progress to the symptomatic infectious class at an age-dependent rate k(a).
A fraction 1-ρ of exposed individuals progress to the asymptomatic infectious class at an age-dependent rate k(a).
Symptomatic infectious individuals recover at an age-specific rate γ_1(a).
Asymptomatic individuals are reinfected through mosquito bites and become symptomatic infectious.
Asymptomatic infectious individuals recover at an age-specific rate γ_2(a).
Susceptible mosquitoes become infected through biting asymptomatic or symptomatically infectious human hosts.

Name: B
Description: The constant influx rate of the human hosts.

Name: μ_h
Description: The natural death rate of the human hosts.

Name: μ_v
Description: The natural death rate of the mosquitoes.

Name: γ_1(a)
Description: The age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: γ_2(a)
Description: The age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: β_v(a)
Description: The age-specific transmission rate from infectious hosts to susceptible mosquitoes.

Name: β_h(a)
Description: The age-specific transmission rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible hosts.

Name: ρ
Description: The probability of exposed hosts transferring to symptomatic infectious hosts.

Name: σ
Description: The factor characterizing the intensity of reinfection of asymptomatic infectious hosts.
